title: Play rules
summary: A play rule limits when a track may play. You create named rules here and apply them to tracks (mostly jingles) or to whole playlists.

entities.text: From and to, in station time, with optional weekdays. A window may cross midnight, for example 22:00 to 02:00.
The track does not start again until this many minutes after its last start.
The most times the track may start within the same clock hour.
The tracks and playlists the rule applies to. A playlist rule is checked for each of its tracks separately.

usage: A rule can combine a time window, a minimum interval, and a per-hour limit; at least one must be set, and all set parts must pass. A track follows its own rules and the rules of its playlists. A rule only limits: how often a jingle slot appears in the hour is set by the clock.
steps: Click Add rule and enter a name that says what it does.
Set a time window, a minimum interval, a per-hour limit, or a combination.
Save, then choose the tracks and playlists the rule applies to.
Check the clock dry check for hours in which no track passes.
mistakes: Setting only one end of the time window. Set both times or neither.
Expecting a rule to make a track play more often. Rules only block; clocks create the slots.
Restricting every jingle of a playlist to the same window. Outside it, the jingle slots stay empty and you get warnings.

example.title: Morning and midday jingles
example.text: Rule "Morning": 06:00 to 08:00, applied to jingle A. Rule "Midday": 10:00 to 12:00, and rule "Once per hour": 1 play per hour, both applied to jingle B. At 07:15 only jingle A may play. At 11:00 jingle B plays once, then other jingles fill the remaining slots of that hour.

operations.create: At least one limit is required.
operations.edit: Changes apply to hours planned from now on.
operations.delete: A rule applied to any track or playlist cannot be deleted. The message lists them; remove the rule from them first.

name.label: Name
name.text: Say what the rule does, for example "Morning 06:00 to 10:00".

window_from.label: From
window_from.text: Start of the allowed time, HH:MM in station time. Set together with To.

window_to.label: To
window_to.text: End of the allowed time. Earlier than From when the window crosses midnight.

weekdays.label: Weekdays
weekdays.text: Days on which the window applies. None chosen means every day. For a window across midnight, the day it starts.

min_interval_minutes.label: Minimum interval
min_interval_minutes.text: Minutes between two starts of the same track. At most 7 days.

max_per_hour.label: Plays per hour
max_per_hour.text: The most starts of the same track within one clock hour.

notes.label: Notes
notes.text: Why the rule exists, for your own reference.

track_ids.label: Tracks
track_ids.text: Tracks the rule applies to directly.

playlist_ids.label: Playlists
playlist_ids.text: Playlists whose every track follows the rule.
